hypotheses.text: If Marcus Quill had passed to Ilan Moreau (CM) instead, the sequence would have resulted in a higher chance of a goal than the blocked long-range shot (i.e., passing was the better option).

If Marcus Quill had passed to Theo Varga (CM) instead, the possession would have been retained with a higher expected goal value than the low-probability shot (i.e., a central pass would have produced a better scoring opportunity).
